chars.DAD: a Moroccan father in his late fifties with short grey hair, a trimmed grey beard, rectangular glasses, wearing a beige knitted cardigan over a white shirt and dark brown trousers
chars.GIRL: a 24-year-old Moroccan woman with long dark wavy hair held by a mustard-yellow headband, wearing an oversized lilac hoodie and light blue jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. Seen from the bedroom doorway: DAD has just walked into GIRL's bedroom in a Kenitra apartment and sits down on the edge of her bed next to her, leaning toward her with a serious, pleading face; GIRL sits with arms crossed, looking away stubbornly. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, subjects centred, calm walls at the edges. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. Close two-shot on the bed: DAD gestures with both open hands, trying hard to convince GIRL, worried eyebrows; GIRL listens with a tense frown, clutching a pillow. Faces visible in the upper-middle of the frame. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. GIRL stands up facing DAD, one hand pressed on her heart, eyes shining with determination, speaking firmly; DAD looks up at her from the bed, surprised and resigned. Warm bedroom light, faces in the central area. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. GIRL sits at a wooden living-room table covered with paper documents, passport photocopies and a plain folder, happily sorting the papers with a small smile, a glass of mint tea beside her. Moroccan salon with low sofas in the soft-focus background. Papers are blank with no readable writing. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. Close-up of GIRL at the table, frozen in shock, eyes wide and mouth open, holding one blank document sheet up in both hands, the other papers scattered in front of her. Dramatic light on her face, face in the upper-middle of the frame. Papers have no readable writing. No text.
